pending_interview.question: You've just joined a large cross-functional program as the engineering lead. Three weeks in, you realize that the product manager you depend on most is consistently making scope commitments to senior stakeholders without consulting you first — promises that affect your team's capacity and timeline. You've raised it once informally and nothing changed. Describe specifically how you handle it from here.
